subject: MSA + Order Form: Uptime matrix consolidation and maintenance scheduling
messages:
From: Ayesha Khan <ayesha.k@gridpay.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom R. <tom.r@gridpay.com>, GridPay Legal <contracts@gridpay.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Jun 2025 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MSA / Order Form redlines - uptime & maintenance windows

Connor,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Attached are GridPay's redlines to the Order Form plus a proposed SLO matrix (SLO_Matrix_GridPay_v0.9.xlsx). High level asks from procurement/legal:

- Tighten P1 response SLA to 15 minutes for critical transaction failures (they want confirmation this maps to our P1 definition).
- Reduce excessive blackout periods: propose limiting rolling maintenance to 2 hours per week per region unless pre-approved.
- Clarify service credit calculation for partial-month outages and cap aggregation across regions.

Can your legal/ops team confirm if these are feasible or provide counter-positions? We have a procurement milestone on 6/20 so hoping to close a narrow set of items quickly. I've also attached a suggested calendar for maintenance windows.

Attachments: GridPay_OrderForm_v2_redlines.docx, SLO_Matrix_GridPay_v0.9.xlsx, maintenance_calendar_proposal.ics

Regards,
Ayesha Khan
Head of Procurement | GridPay

---

P.S. If easier, we can do a 30m call Tues 6/16 to run through items.

From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
To: Ayesha Khan <ayesha.k@gridpay.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>, kimberly_park <kimberly@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Jun 2025 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MSA / Order Form redlines - uptime & maintenance windows

Ayesha — thanks for the redlines and SLO matrix. Looping in Laura (Product Ops) and Kimberly (Legal) to validate. Quick notes from infra/ops perspective before legal weighs in:

- P1 15-minute acknowledgement: our standard is a 15-min acknowledgement window for critical incidents and a 60-min targeted mitigation start for complex infrastructure P1s. We can accept 15-min acknowledgement as long as the Order Form maps your P1 to our incident taxonomy (I'll attach a mapping doc).
- Rolling maintenance: we agree a default 2-hour/week per region is reasonable but need to preserve exceptions for emergency patches. We propose adding an emergency patch carve-out with notification windows and an approvals matrix.
- Credits: service-credit math in your sheet looks consumable; main ask is whether credits will be pro-rated for partial-month outages and whether regional aggregation applies. Ops prefers per-region calculation to avoid double-dipping.

We can take these as action items and surface a clean counterproposal from legal by EOD 6/16. If you have a hard procurement milestone on 6/20, let's do a 30-min call today at 11am PT to align.

Connor
Director, Customer Solutions | Redwood Inference

Attachment referenced: internal_SLO_mapping_v1.pdf (internal draft)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>, Ayesha Khan <ayesha.k@gridpay.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>, GridPay Legal <contracts@gridpay.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Jun 2025 12:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MSA / Order Form redlines - uptime & maintenance windows

Ayesha / Connor / team — I reviewed GridPay's redlines and the SLO matrix. High-level legal positions and proposed phrasing below:

1) P1 definition mapping: we will include a definition appendix that explicitly maps GridPay's "critical transaction failures" to our P1 taxonomy. Proposed language: "P1 (Critical Transaction Failure): system outages causing loss of ability to process payment transactions for > X minutes..." Please confirm the threshold X.

2) Response/acknowledgement vs mitigation: we can accept a 15-minute acknowledgement time. We will resist committing to mitigation completion timelines in the MSA; instead propose mitigation milestones (acknowledge, begin mitigation, ETA updates) with target windows.

3) Maintenance windows and emergency patches: add carve-out language for security/emergency fixes that allows Redwood to schedule unscheduled remediation with notification and post-facto reporting. We will limit emergency changes to scope and require coordination with GridPay's on-call.

4) Credits: propose per-region measurement with a reconciliation clause. We will agree to pro-rated credits for partial-month outages but request a credit cap no greater than 30% of monthly recurring charges and a 90-day lookback window for aggregation.

Action items:
- Laura: produce an ops-friendly SLO appendix mapping by EOD 6/16.
- Connor: follow up with a short redline of the credit math showing per-region examples.
- Ayesha / GridPay: confirm threshold for "critical transaction" (suggested 5 minutes to trigger P1).

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference

Attachment: proposed_slo_appendix_draft.docx (attaching a small redline excerpt)

From: Ayesha Khan <ayesha.k@gridpay.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Tom R. <tom.r@gridpay.com>, GridPay Legal <contracts@gridpay.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Jun 2025 11:32:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MSA / Order Form redlines - uptime & maintenance windows

Thanks everyone — this is helpful. Quick responses:

- GridPay is comfortable with mapping P1 to Redwood's taxonomy provided the trigger for "critical transaction" is 5 minutes (i.e., if payments fail for 5 continuous minutes we will declare P1).
- Emergency patch carve-out OK — please add a requirement for post-remediation incident report within 48 hours for transparency.
- Credits: GridPay accepts per-region crediting and a 30% monthly cap, provided we have a 60-day reconciliation window (instead of 90).

Next steps: if Redwood can provide the ops SLO appendix and a redlined credit example by EOD 6/17, GridPay will finalize procurement internal approvals and route to Legal for sign-off on 6/18. If that lands, we aim to get countersigned by 6/24.

I'll join the 11am PT call tomorrow to go over the appendix.

Best,
Ayesha
Head of Procurement | GridPay
